description: Form 6251 line 2f is limited to 90% of AMTI figured without it: single 2026, wages $116,100, pre-2018 NOL $100,000 (deducted in full), ATNOLD entered $100,000. Line 1b = 16,100 − 16,100 = $0; + line 2a 16,100 + line 2e 100,000 = $116,100; 90% = $104,490 ≥ 100,000 → line 2f −$100,000 → AMTI $16,100. With ATNOLD $110,000 the limit binds: AMTI 116,100 − 104,490 = $11,610.
